title: Polyester/cotton blend. Average softness compared to other poly blends. Loose threads after washing
text:
Polyester/cotton blend. Average softness compared to other poly blends. Loose threads after washing. First off do not mistake the description for actual 800 thread count "cotton". These are a blend - 55% cotton and 45% polyester to be exact. I am not a fan of this trend in bedding products of listing thread count in big, highlighted print on the label and then the tidbit about it being a blend in small print way below in the description. (Real 800 thread count cotton pillow cases usually cost three figures by the way)

For a polyester blend fabric, these pillow cases are of average quality. They are soft and feel ok against your face - they aren't scratchy or rough by any measure. Mine are standard size and our extra thick, shredded latex pillows fit without oozing out. After washing and drying them in a normal cycle with warm water and a set of sheets in a similar thread count blend, these pillow cases didn't shrink. However.... I do see a couple of little loose threads in the top, decorative hemstitch. So my bottom line is a one star deduction for silliness with phrasing and description and a one star deduction for overall quality versus value.
